source.title: Trump Loses Both House And Senate BUT Bitcoin Rips To $81K Anyway
source.description:
🔴 LIVE – A Satoshi-era Bitcoin wallet dormant since 2010 just moved for the first time ever — sixteen years of silence, broken — while Bitcoin ripped to $81,000 and $320M in shorts got wiped out in thirty minutes. The real story here isn't the price, it's the wallet.

In this Bitcast live roundup you'll see exactly what the Satoshi-era wallet move means, with $1.7 million in untouched gains sitting since 2014. You'll hear Michael Saylor explain how Bitcoin reserve support just crossed party lines after the midterms — a Republican governor and a Democratic senator backing the same reserve. You'
